summary: Three disjoint physical 2-coordinate packet principal blocks may each equal diag(1,-1), with determinant magnitude and sigma_min both 1, while arbitrary interpacket bilinear couplings collapse their 6-coordinate union to J3 direct_sum (-J3), global rank two. For independent Uniform[-1/2,1/2] coordinates the resulting Q0=(sum x_i)^2-(sum y_i)^2 has p_Q0(q)>=(1/8)log(1/(4|q|)) near zero. Adding an independent z^2 makes the full matrix spectrum {3,-3,1,0,0,0,0}, hence target-valid, but conditioning on z still leaves an unbounded conditional density. The unconditional target-valid form is bounded (<=3pi/4). Therefore local pair curvature parameters and repeated conditional L^(3/2) packet smoothing cannot by themselves survive arbitrary interpacket coupling; a third global curvature resource or an outside independent bank must be retained jointly. This refutes only the intermediate proof interface, not QFORM.
replacement: Use the third singular direction of the full active packet union as a gate; if it is small, the escaped-third-curvature lemma forces operator-norm resource into the outside cross/self blocks, which must be retained jointly rather than conditioned away.
